question: offline, on the recorded M1 test frames: how accurately does a tag-free floor/wall-boundary scan PF localize, compared with the tag PF on the same frames and with issued-command dead reckoning?
claim_scope: feasibility probe only: open-loop replay of trajectories driven by the tag PF; no closed-loop or success claim; tags are physically present in the frames (not used)

filters.boundary: v3 (calibration_dev.json), dock prior (static spawn row) +-0.15 m / +-10 deg
filters.tag_replay: M1 tag PF replayed offline (same detector/calibration)
filters.tag_online: tag PF of the recorded run (eval_only/frames_eval.jsonl)

metrics: per-frame position error vs eval-only GT (p50/p90/p99/max, share < 5 / 10 cm), yaw error p50/p90; pooled and per phase group (search_approach, door_zone = |x-2.2|<0.6 and -0.45<y<0.55, carry, manipulate, look_back)
reference_needs: door 0.5 m wide; M1 placement GT slot errors were 1-4 cm with tags
